text: Good evening ma. Please I am sorry to disturb you this night. I am the grandfather of Amaka, she is 9 years. Her temperature is 38.5 since evening time. The thing that is worrying me is her neck. She cannot bend her head forward at all, I told her to look down at her stomach and she refused, she said she cannot do it, the neck is too stiff. Her breathing is normal o, no problem there. Her parents travelled and I am the one with her. Please what should I do? I don't want to be bothering you for nothing but I am not easy in my mind.
